criteria.statement: Reconciler uses the shared environment apply lock path for auto-remediation and does not block behind active user operations.
auto_apply invokes the shared desired-state deploy helper using the persisted desired artifact/state.
approval_required marks drift as remediation_needed and waits for an authorized 5968 event.
Auto-remediation failure or lock contention preserves desired state, stores failure metadata, and applies backoff.
Internal auto-remediation does not synthesize fake external control-plane events.
Normative deployment docs describe reconciliation behavior.
